title: Samsung’s memory chip employees negotiated $340,000 bonuses this year
brief: Samsung's 48,000 semiconductor workers secured a tentative deal offering average annual bonuses of $340,000 after threatening an 18-day strike, with all chip division employees now eligible to receive 50% of their annual salary as a regular bonus. The agreement came after SK Hynix raised its own bonus caps, intensifying competitive pressure during a boom in AI chip demand.
